I just ordered some 5-meo-amt and I have been experimenting with different doses, on Friday my friend wanna try it and I figured I pretty much got the dose down and I give 6mg to my friend. This was at 8:00 am.
At around 9 he took some dxm probably around 500-750 mg but it wasnt measured.
At 12:00 he drank an unknown amount but at 1:45 when I got told he was having a bad trip he reeked like alcohol he was having trouble breathing and had to go to the hospital, he turned all blue and shit but hes ok now.
